# FG-CI-0013

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`merge-blocked`](../../ops/runbooks/merge-blocked.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_required_check_of_an_older_merge_result_is_stale_and_blocks_the_merge` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 必須のチェックは、進む前の対象のブランチでのマージ結果のものです。「準備ができたらマージ」でマージキューに任せるか、今の対象でパイプラインを実行し、通ってからマージしてください。
- en: A required check belongs to the merge result of an older target. Use Merge when ready to let the merge queue test it on the current target, or run the pipeline on the current target and merge once it passes.
- id: Pemeriksaan wajib berasal dari hasil penggabungan target yang lama. Gunakan Gabungkan saat siap agar antrean merge mengujinya pada target saat ini, atau jalankan pipeline pada target saat ini lalu gabungkan setelah lulus.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C7 (plan 04 M-1 / M-2, ADR-0024 Amendment 2026-11-11): the merge request's first blocking reason is `required_check_stale` — a check the target's merge rule requires has no run on the CURRENT merge result (the merge of the head into the live target tip, `refs/merge-requests/<iid>/merge`, a row of forge.merge_result_refs) but has one on an EARLIER merge result of the same head (the target branch advanced since). A run on an older merge result is stale whatever its conclusion. Precedence per required name: a run on the current merge result counts. Only a name forge itself reports on merge results (`ci/pipeline`, the MR pipeline's) can be stale: its run on an older merge result of the head is stale, and a run on the head never satisfies it (a push pipeline's). For any other name (external reporters: the Checks API accepts only commits a branch or tag reaches) a run on the head counts and a run only an older merge result holds is ignored (missing, never stale: a removed or renamed job never blocks forever). Answered at the merge request (`POST …/merge-requests/{iid}/merge`, nothing written) or inside the merge job under the lock (the attempt is `superseded`, no ref moved); the merge status lists the same reason with `name=<check>`. Plan 18 S5 (ADR-0037): a target move writes the new merge result WITHOUT a merge request pipeline (only a new head's first merge result gets one; `ci.mr_pipeline_on_target_move = true` restores the old behaviour), so after a landing on the target this is the expected answer of a direct merge, not a pipeline that is late. The error body carries `hint: merge_queue` (the next step a client can take).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reasons`, `details` (`required_check_stale:name=<check>`), `merge_request_id` and `head_sha`. `gstn mr status --json` shows `merge_result_sha` (the current merge result; null while it is being computed, on a conflict or when the target is gone) and `checks[].stale: true`. forge.merge_result_refs lists the merge results of the head (`target_sha`, `result_sha`, one row per pair); the MR pipeline of the new merge result is `gstn pipeline list --project <id>` (source merge_request, sha = merge_result_sha). The event `forge.review.merge_result_updated` (info) logs every new merge result with `request_id`, `pipeline_enqueued` and `pipeline` (`on_new_head` / `on_target_move` / `requested`): `pipeline_enqueued=false` with `on_new_head` is a target move (by design). The merge status's `checks[].target_sha` says which target tip the run is as of. A person's run on the current target logs `forge.ci.merge_request_pipeline_asked` (`outcome` queued / exists / computing).

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing to fix in the change. Either use the merge queue (the page's Merge when ready, or `POST …/merge-requests/{iid}/merge-queue`): its train's pipeline tests the merge on the current target and lands it — no merge request pipeline is needed. Or run the merge request pipeline on the current target (the page's button, `POST …/merge-requests/{iid}/pipeline`), wait for it to pass on merge_result_sha, then merge directly. If the run answers `computing`, the merge result of the current target is being written first (plan 18 S4: a result carried over a landing that does not touch the merge request's files has none, and the refusal's log context carries `mergeability=carried`; the refusal itself requested the computed check, info `forge.review.mergeability_carried_recompute_requested`); the pipeline follows it. If no merge result appears at all, the mergeability check is pending or failed (reason mergeability_unknown first; runbook merge-blocked).
